constraints: Follow NPS journey brief: Proceed → confirm employee details → PRAN yes → 12-digit PRAN → PDF proof upload → Opt IN/OUT → (opt-in) tax regime + % → success. Each phase completes when the bot reaches the NEXT step in the brief, not the final confirmation.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
name: NPS opt out happy flow
goal: Successfully opt out of the National Pension Scheme

phases.description: Proceed through NPS intro and confirm employee details
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks if user has PRAN or shows Opt IN/Opt OUT

phases.description: Enter PRAN if needed, upload proof if asked, choose Opt OUT
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms NPS opt-out was submitted successfully
